snippet.title: ♾️The official trailer for Version 1.11 "Encore Season" is now live!
snippet.description:
♾️The official trailer for Version 1.11 "Encore Season" is now live!

The "Unleash Your Style: Super Styling Contest" has officially kicked off in Wishfield!
Step into the competition and showcase your one-of-a-kind style and boundless creativity on the grand stage!
With three groups vying for the championship, how many trials and challenges will you face on your way to the top?

As the candlestick lights the way to the past and old friends reunite, it's not sorrow we feel—but the warmth of shared memories.
Remember, every encounter is a miracle!

Infinity Nikki Version 1.11 "Encore Season" goes live on October 27 (UTC-7)!
Get ready for the styling groups and so much more! Stylists, don't miss out on the excitement—dive in and explore!

—— 
The Coziest Open-World Game!
Infinity Nikki Version 1.11 "Encore Season" launches globally on October 27 (UTC-7)!

#InfinityNikki
#EncoreSeason
